# Pangle
> Pangle is a mobile advertising and monetization platform by ByteDance for app developers and advertisers.

Pangle provides tools for app monetization, user acquisition, ad delivery, reporting, and integration across mobile apps. Its public site includes product information, help center resources, developer documentation, and integration guidance for publishers and advertisers.

## Main Site
- [Pangle Home](https://www.pangle.io/): Overview of Pangle’s mobile advertising and app monetization platform.
- [Monetization](https://www.pangle.io/monetization): Product page for app publishers seeking ad monetization solutions.
- [User Acquisition](https://www.pangle.io/user-acquisition): Product page for advertisers focused on app growth and acquisition.
- [About](https://www.pangle.io/about): Company overview and background on Pangle’s platform and mission.
- [Contact](https://www.pangle.io/contact): Contact page for sales, partnerships, and general platform inquiries.

## Publishers
- [Publishers Overview](https://www.pangle.io/monetization): Introduction to monetization products and publisher benefits.
- [App Monetization](https://www.pangle.io/monetization): Overview of ad monetization capabilities for mobile apps.
- [Ad Formats](https://www.pangle.io/monetization): Summary of supported ad experiences and monetization options.
- [Global Demand](https://www.pangle.io/monetization): Information on advertiser demand and revenue opportunities for publishers.

## Advertisers
- [Advertisers Overview](https://www.pangle.io/user-acquisition): Introduction to user acquisition and advertising solutions.
- [App Growth](https://www.pangle.io/user-acquisition): Overview of campaign tools for acquiring mobile app users.
- [Performance Advertising](https://www.pangle.io/user-acquisition): Information on optimization and performance-driven advertising.
- [Global Reach](https://www.pangle.io/user-acquisition): Details on reaching users across markets through Pangle inventory.

## Help Center
- [Help Center Home](https://www.pangle.io/help): Central support hub for publishers and advertisers.
- [Publisher Support](https://www.pangle.io/help): Help resources related to monetization and account operations.
- [Advertiser Support](https://www.pangle.io/help): Help resources for campaign setup, billing, and optimization.
- [Policy Support](https://www.pangle.io/help): Access point for policy and compliance-related support materials.

## Developers
- [Developers Home](https://www.pangle.io/developer): Entry point for SDK integration and technical resources.
- [Integration Guides](https://www.pangle.io/developer): Technical setup materials for integrating Pangle into apps.
- [SDK Resources](https://www.pangle.io/developer): Developer materials for mobile SDK implementation and maintenance.
- [Technical Documentation](https://www.pangle.io/developer): Documentation hub for engineering teams integrating ads.

## SDK Integration
- [Android Integration](https://www.pangle.io/developer): Guidance for integrating the Pangle SDK in Android apps.
- [iOS Integration](https://www.pangle.io/developer): Guidance for integrating the Pangle SDK in iOS apps.
- [Ad Format Setup](https://www.pangle.io/developer): Instructions for implementing supported ad formats in apps.
- [Testing and Debugging](https://www.pangle.io/developer): Resources for validating integrations and troubleshooting issues.

## Policies
- [Policies Overview](https://www.pangle.io/help): General platform policies and compliance information.
- [Publisher Policies](https://www.pangle.io/help): Rules and requirements for publishers using Pangle monetization.
- [Advertiser Policies](https://www.pangle.io/help): Rules and requirements for advertisers running campaigns.
- [Content Compliance](https://www.pangle.io/help): Guidance on ad content standards and platform compliance expectations.

## Resources
- [Blog](https://www.pangle.io/blog): Articles, announcements, and insights related to mobile advertising.
- [Case Studies](https://www.pangle.io/case-study): Customer stories and examples of platform usage and outcomes.
- [Insights](https://www.pangle.io/blog): Educational content on monetization, advertising, and app growth.
- [News and Updates](https://www.pangle.io/blog): Product and company updates published by Pangle.

## Account Access
- [Sign In](https://www.pangle.io/signin): Login page for existing Pangle users.
- [Get Started](https://www.pangle.io/): Starting point for new publishers and advertisers evaluating Pangle.
- [Contact Sales](https://www.pangle.io/contact): Inquiry page for commercial discussions and onboarding support.
- [Support Access](https://www.pangle.io/help): Entry point for users seeking operational or technical assistance.
